basics.name: Fernando Gelin
basics.label: Head of AI Products, MarianaTek
basics.summary: Engineering and product leader with a strong hands-on foundation in software architecture, team development, and AI. Experienced in translating complex problems into practical products, setting technical direction, and leading teams from exploration through production.

highlights: Build and deploy MarianaTek’s MCP connector, in-product AI features, and customer-facing agentic messaging, owning implementation through production deployment
Set AI strategy and roadmap across customer-facing products and the internal platform

Define the strategy and process for agentic development across the software lifecycle, creating reusable AI agent skills for spec-driven development and collaboration among engineers, product managers, and designers
Build conversational and agentic experiences for studio operators and their customers, spanning scheduling, member communications, and operational workflows
Establish the internal AI platform: tooling, infrastructure, and patterns that enable every engineer to ship AI features safely

work.position: Senior Engineering Manager | Frontend Software Architect – MarianaTek
highlights: Led a team of 9 full-stack engineers building scalable web applications for boutique fitness studios, delivering seamless experiences across scheduling, payments, and client management
Drove frontend architecture strategy including microfrontend adoption, enabling independent team deployments and faster iteration cycles
Architected and implemented AI-native features and conversational interfaces, integrating LLM capabilities into production workflows
Partnered with Product, Design, and executive leadership to translate business objectives into technical roadmaps, balancing feature delivery with platform stability
Championed frontend best practices including accessibility (WCAG), design system consistency, and performance optimization
Mentored engineers at all levels, conducted architecture reviews, and fostered a culture of technical excellence and ownership
Upgraded the legacy Ember.js application to newer versions and built features in React-based applications
Started the company's Web Components-based design system and integrated it into the Ember.js application
Led performance optimization initiatives, significantly improving load times and application responsiveness
Collaborated cross-functionally with Product, Design, and QA to improve accessibility and usability

work.position: Senior Research Software Engineer – Center for Computation and Visualization
highlights: Built, deployed, and maintained research web applications for scientists and students, from one-off tools to distributed systems used by thousands of students
Mentored undergraduate interns and graduate students in version control, testing, and collaborative software development
Built interactive data visualization tools and web applications in close collaboration with data scientists and research teams
Developed Honeycomb, an open-source framework for real-time psychophysiological data collection, supporting NIH BRAIN Initiative research
Implemented real-time data streaming pipelines for synchronized behavioral and neurophysiological recordings
Created D3.js-based visualizations for complex research datasets, enabling researchers to explore and analyze experimental results
Published peer-reviewed research on reproducible psychophysiological task frameworks (Nature Medicine, Brazilian Journal of Psychiatry)

work.position: Research Software Engineer – Center for Computation and Visualization
highlights: Worked in the Data Science Practice and then the new Center for Computation and Visualization, collaborating with the Brown Center for Biomedical Informatics and Computational Biology Core on research software for data management, analysis, and visualization
Supported researchers and students in creating self-contained Docker and Singularity environments for Brown’s secure computing ecosystem

work.position: Data Science Associate – Data Science Practice
highlights: Worked with Brown research groups on exploratory data analysis, machine learning, visualization, web development, and software engineering
Analyzed and visualized data with the Rhode Island Innovative Policy Lab to help researchers design and test data-informed policy

work.position: Senior Research Fellow – UW Medicine Department of Psychiatry
highlights: Analyzed human genome sequences using GATK, Picard, and BWA
Built Python and shell pipelines for demultiplexing, alignment, coverage analysis, and variant calling of targeted sequencing data
Created an R Shiny application to explore and visualize genetic variant data
Built an Ember.js application for lab use that generated molecular inversion probe protocols and calculated reagent amounts
